categories.name: Events
categories.doc: Triggers that start an event: scene start, collisions, timers, custom events.

categories.name: Conditions
categories.doc: Tests and comparisons. Several conditions = AND; right-click the event for OR; invert for NOT.

categories.name: Loops & flow
categories.doc: Repeat, While, For, For each, Wait and Stop loop.

categories.name: Objects
categories.doc: Create, destroy, pick and change objects.

categories.name: Physics
categories.doc: Forces, gravity, collisions, raycasts, grab and throw.

categories.name: AI
categories.doc: Pathfinding, patrol, chase, flee, line of sight.

categories.name: Timers
categories.doc: Every X seconds and named timers.

categories.name: Game flow
categories.doc: Pause, restart, scenes, checkpoints, win and lose.

blocks.name: On start of scene
blocks.doc: Runs once when the scene starts (or restarts).

blocks.name: On game start
blocks.doc: Runs once when the game is first launched (not on restarts).

blocks.name: Every tick
blocks.doc: True every frame (60 fixed ticks per second). Use dt for frame-independent movement.

blocks.name: On fixed physics update
blocks.doc: Runs every fixed step right after behaviors and physics move objects, before the rest of the sheet.

blocks.name: On custom event
blocks.doc: Runs when "Trigger custom event" is used with the same name.

blocks.name: On collision with
blocks.doc: Runs once when the object starts overlapping another object. Both objects are picked.
blocks.c2: Object: On collision with another object

blocks.name: On collision exited
blocks.doc: Runs once when two objects stop overlapping.

blocks.name: On trigger entered
blocks.doc: Like On collision, but only for objects whose collider is marked "Is trigger".

blocks.name: On created
blocks.doc: Runs when an instance is created or spawned.

blocks.name: On destroyed
blocks.doc: Runs when an instance is destroyed.

blocks.name: On object clicked
blocks.doc: Runs when the object is clicked with the left mouse button. Picks the clicked instance.

blocks.name: On variable changed
blocks.doc: Runs whenever a global variable changes value.

blocks.name: On damaged
blocks.doc: Runs when the object takes damage.

blocks.name: On health changed
blocks.doc: Runs when health goes up or down.

blocks.name: On died
blocks.doc: Runs once when health reaches 0.

blocks.name: On hit by attack
blocks.doc: Runs when a melee attack or projectile hits this object.

blocks.name: On jump
blocks.doc: Runs when a Platform character jumps.

blocks.name: On landed
blocks.doc: Runs when a Platform character lands.

blocks.name: On car hit
blocks.doc: Runs when a Car hits a solid at speed.

blocks.name: On bullet hit solid
blocks.doc: Runs when a Bullet hits a solid (just before it is destroyed).

blocks.name: On impact
blocks.doc: Runs when a physics body hits something hard.

blocks.name: On arrived
blocks.doc: Runs when a Pathfinding object reaches the end of its path.

blocks.name: On path found
blocks.doc: Runs when Find path succeeds.

blocks.name: On failed to find path
blocks.doc: Runs when no route exists.
blocks.c2: Pathfinding: On failed to find path

blocks.name: On timer
blocks.doc: Runs when a named timer started with "Start timer" finishes.

blocks.name: On animation finished
blocks.doc: Runs when a non-looping animation finishes.

blocks.name: On button clicked
blocks.doc: Runs when a HUD button (text object marked as button) or screen button is clicked.

blocks.name: On function
blocks.doc: Defines a function. Its actions run when "Call function" is used. Read parameters with param(0), param(1)...

blocks.name: On key pressed
blocks.doc: Runs once when the key goes down.

blocks.name: On key released
blocks.doc: Runs once when the key is released.

blocks.name: Key is down
blocks.doc: True while the key is held.

blocks.name: On mouse click
blocks.doc: Runs when a mouse button is pressed. Mouse.X/Y/Z give the cursor position in the world.

blocks.name: Mouse button is down
blocks.doc: True while the mouse button is held.

blocks.name: If
blocks.doc: True when the expression is true. Supports and, or, not, =, <>, <, >, <=, >=.

blocks.name: Compare two values
blocks.doc: Compares two expressions.

blocks.name: Compare variable
blocks.doc: Compares a global or local variable (Variable equals value).

blocks.name: Is boolean set
blocks.doc: True if a boolean variable is true.

blocks.name: Trigger once while true
blocks.doc: Makes the event run only the first tick its other conditions become true.

blocks.name: Random chance
blocks.doc: True with the given probability (uses the seeded random generator).

blocks.name: Object exists
blocks.doc: True if at least one instance exists.

blocks.name: Compare object count
blocks.doc: Compares how many instances of an object exist.

blocks.name: Compare property
blocks.doc: Picks instances whose property matches (Compare X, Compare Y...).
blocks.c2: Object: Compare X / Y / Angle / Opacity

blocks.name: Compare instance variable
blocks.doc: Picks instances whose instance variable matches.

blocks.name: Is boolean instance variable set
blocks.doc: Picks instances whose boolean instance variable is true.
blocks.c2: Object: Is boolean instance variable set

blocks.name: Is visible
blocks.doc: Picks visible instances.

blocks.name: Is overlapping
blocks.doc: Picks instances currently overlapping another object (Is colliding).

blocks.name: Is within distance
blocks.doc: Picks instances within a planar distance of any instance of the other object.

blocks.name: Is moving
blocks.doc: Picks instances whose speed is above 0.05 m/s.

blocks.name: Has tag
blocks.doc: Picks instances that have a tag (Tags and groups).

blocks.name: Pick nearest
blocks.doc: Picks the single closest instance.

blocks.name: Pick by UID
blocks.doc: Picks the instance with a unique ID (object reference).

blocks.name: Pick random instance
blocks.doc: Picks one random instance.

blocks.name: Pick by evaluate
blocks.doc: Picks every instance for which the expression is true. Self is the instance being tested.

blocks.name: Pick all
blocks.doc: Resets picking for this object so later conditions see every instance.

blocks.name: Is on floor
blocks.doc: True when a Platform character is standing on a solid (Is grounded).

blocks.name: Is jumping
blocks.doc: True while moving upwards.

blocks.name: Is falling
blocks.doc: True while moving downwards in the air.

blocks.name: Is holding an object
blocks.doc: True if the object has grabbed something.

blocks.name: Detect ground
blocks.doc: Raycasts downward against solids.

blocks.name: Detect wall
blocks.doc: Raycasts forward (along the angle) against solids.

blocks.name: Raycast hits
blocks.doc: Casts a ray along the object angle. If the first thing hit is the other object, it is picked. Solids block the ray.

blocks.name: Has line of sight
blocks.doc: True if no solid blocks the straight line to the other object.
blocks.c2: Line of sight: Has LOS to object

blocks.name: Compare health
blocks.doc: Has sufficient health? Compares current hit points.

blocks.name: Is dead
blocks.doc: True when health has reached 0.

blocks.name: Is timer running
blocks.doc: Invert to test "Timer finished".

blocks.name: Every X seconds
blocks.doc: True once every interval.

blocks.name: Is animation playing
blocks.doc: True if the named animation is the current animation.

blocks.name: List contains
blocks.doc: Has item? True if the list contains the value.

blocks.name: Repeat
blocks.doc: Repeats the rest of the event. loopindex gives the current iteration.

blocks.name: Repeat while
blocks.doc: Repeats the rest of the event while the expression is true (max 10 000 iterations per tick).

blocks.name: For
blocks.doc: Counts from start to end inclusive. loopindex("name") gives the value.

blocks.name: For each object
blocks.doc: Runs the rest of the event once per picked instance.

blocks.name: For each (ordered)
blocks.doc: Like For each, sorted by an expression evaluated per instance.

blocks.name: For each item
blocks.doc: Runs the rest of the event per list item. Use item() and loopindex.

blocks.name: Wait
blocks.doc: Pauses the remaining actions and sub-events of this event, keeping picked objects, then continues.

blocks.name: Stop loop
blocks.doc: Ends the current Repeat / For / While loop after this iteration (Break).

blocks.name: Set value
blocks.doc: Sets a global or local variable.

blocks.name: Add to
blocks.doc: Adds to a number variable.

blocks.name: Subtract from
blocks.doc: Subtracts from a number variable.

blocks.name: Toggle boolean
blocks.doc: Flips a boolean variable.

blocks.name: Set instance variable
blocks.doc: Sets an instance variable on each picked instance.

blocks.name: Add to instance variable
blocks.doc: Adds to an instance variable.

blocks.name: Toggle instance boolean
blocks.doc: Flips a boolean instance variable.

blocks.name: Save variables
blocks.doc: Saves all number/text/boolean/list/dictionary global variables.

blocks.name: Load variables
blocks.doc: Loads global variables saved with "Save variables".

blocks.name: Log to console
blocks.doc: Writes to the console. Great for debugging.

blocks.name: Add item
blocks.doc: Appends to the end of a list.

blocks.name: Set item
blocks.doc: Replaces an item (0-based).

blocks.name: Remove item
blocks.doc: Removes an item by index.

blocks.name: Remove value
blocks.doc: Removes the first matching item.

blocks.name: Clear list
blocks.doc: Removes every item.

blocks.name: Set key
blocks.doc: Adds or replaces a dictionary key.

blocks.name: Delete key
blocks.doc: Removes a dictionary key.

blocks.name: Call function
blocks.doc: Runs every "On function" event with this name, immediately. Use call("name", ...) in expressions to get a return value.

blocks.name: Set return value
blocks.doc: Sets the value returned to call(...).

blocks.name: Trigger custom event
blocks.doc: Runs every "On custom event" with the same name.

blocks.name: Create object
blocks.doc: Creates a new instance. It becomes the picked instance for the following actions.

blocks.name: Spawn another object
blocks.doc: Creates an object at this object, facing the same way.

blocks.name: Destroy
blocks.doc: Removes the picked instances (and their children).

blocks.name: Set visible
blocks.doc: Shows or hides the object.

blocks.name: Set opacity
blocks.doc: Sets transparency (0 = invisible, 100 = solid).

blocks.name: Set color
blocks.doc: Tints the object.

blocks.name: Set scale
blocks.doc: Sets the scale.

blocks.name: Attach to object
blocks.doc: Makes the object a child of the first picked instance of another object, keeping its offset.

blocks.name: Add tag
blocks.doc: Adds a tag (group).

blocks.name: Remove tag
blocks.doc: Removes a tag.

blocks.name: Set behavior enabled
blocks.doc: Enables or disables a behavior (e.g. turn movement on/off).

blocks.name: Set position
blocks.doc: Moves instantly (Teleport).

blocks.name: Set position to object
blocks.doc: Moves to the first picked instance of another object.
blocks.c2: Object: Set position to another object

blocks.name: Move by
blocks.doc: Moves relative to the current position, respecting solids if the object has a movement behavior.

blocks.name: Move forward
blocks.doc: Moves along the object angle. Use "speed * dt" for smooth movement.

blocks.name: Move toward position
blocks.doc: Moves straight toward a point without overshooting.

blocks.name: Move toward object
blocks.doc: Moves straight toward another object (use AI > Find path to route around walls).

blocks.name: Set velocity
blocks.doc: Sets the velocity used by Platform, Physics and 8 Direction behaviors.

blocks.name: Set angle
blocks.doc: Sets the heading in degrees (0 = +X, counter-clockwise).

blocks.name: Rotate
blocks.doc: Turns counter-clockwise (negative = clockwise).

blocks.name: Set rotation (3D)
blocks.doc: Sets full Euler rotation in degrees.

blocks.name: Look at object
blocks.doc: Turns to face another object (Set angle toward position).

blocks.name: Look at position
blocks.doc: Turns to face a point (e.g. the mouse).

blocks.name: Set movement speed
blocks.doc: Sets the max speed of Platform, 8 Direction, Car, Pathfinding or Bullet on the object.

blocks.name: Simulate control
blocks.doc: Walk, run or jump as if a key were pressed this tick (for AI and custom controls).

blocks.name: Jump
blocks.doc: Makes a Platform character jump if it is on the floor.

blocks.name: Set jump strength
blocks.doc: Changes how high the character jumps.

blocks.name: Set platform gravity
blocks.doc: Changes the Platform gravity.

blocks.name: Fly
blocks.doc: Sets the vertical speed of a Platform or Physics object (hold to hover).

blocks.name: Change follow target
blocks.doc: Changes what a Follow behavior (e.g. the camera) follows.

blocks.name: Apply force
blocks.doc: Continuous force in newtons (use every tick).

blocks.name: Apply impulse
blocks.doc: Instant push (changes velocity by impulse / mass).

blocks.name: Set gravity
blocks.doc: Changes gravity for Physics objects (negative = down).

blocks.name: Change mass
blocks.doc: Heavier objects are harder to push and throw.

blocks.name: Change friction
blocks.doc: How quickly the object stops sliding on the ground.

blocks.name: Change bounce
blocks.doc: Restitution: 0 = no bounce, 1 = perfect bounce.

blocks.name: Create rigidbody
blocks.doc: Adds the Physics behavior at runtime.

blocks.name: Create collider
blocks.doc: Changes the collision shape.

blocks.name: Grab nearest object
blocks.doc: Picks up the closest Physics object in range and carries it in front.

blocks.name: Drop object
blocks.doc: Releases the carried object.

blocks.name: Throw object
blocks.doc: Releases the carried object with an impulse along the facing direction.

blocks.name: Apply explosion force
blocks.doc: Pushes every Physics object away from a point, weaker with distance.

blocks.name: Deal damage
blocks.doc: Subtracts health (respects invulnerability time). Fires On damaged / On died.

blocks.name: Heal
blocks.doc: Adds health up to the maximum.

blocks.name: Set health
blocks.doc: Sets current health (and revives if above 0).

blocks.name: Shoot projectile
blocks.doc: Spawns a projectile facing the shooter angle. Projectiles damage objects with Health that they hit (not their owner).

blocks.name: Perform melee attack
blocks.doc: Damages every target inside the range and arc in front of the attacker (Detect hit). Fires On hit by attack.

blocks.name: Apply knockback
blocks.doc: Pushes away from another object.

blocks.name: Equip weapon
blocks.doc: Sets the "weapon" instance variable and shows only the child object with that name or type (others tagged "weapon" are hidden). Use "none" to unequip.

blocks.name: Switch weapon
blocks.doc: Cycles to the next weapon in the list.

blocks.name: Respawn
blocks.doc: Moves the object, stops it and restores full health.

blocks.name: Find path
blocks.doc: Plans a route around solids with A* and starts moving (Move to target).

blocks.name: Chase object
blocks.doc: Finds a path to the nearest instance of the target (Chase player / Navigate around walls).

blocks.name: Stop moving
blocks.doc: Clears the current path.

blocks.name: Patrol
blocks.doc: Walks to a random reachable point near where it started.

blocks.name: Flee
blocks.doc: Finds a path to a point away from the threat.

blocks.name: Set AI state
blocks.doc: Sets the "state" instance variable used by state machines (Choose behavior). Compare it with Compare instance variable.

blocks.name: Start timer
blocks.doc: Starts a named timer. Adds the Timer behavior if missing.

blocks.name: Stop timer
blocks.doc: Cancels a timer.

blocks.name: Play sound
blocks.doc: Plays a built-in synthesized sound or an imported audio asset.

blocks.name: Play spatial sound
blocks.doc: Plays a sound positioned at the object (louder when the camera is near).

blocks.name: Play music
blocks.doc: Loops background music (replaces current music).

blocks.name: Stop sound
blocks.doc: Stops music or every sound.

blocks.name: Change volume
blocks.doc: Changes the master volume.

blocks.name: Trigger audio effect
blocks.doc: Applies an effect to all sounds.

blocks.name: Spawn particle system
blocks.doc: Creates a one-shot emitter from a preset.

blocks.name: Spawn particles at object
blocks.doc: Creates a one-shot emitter at each picked instance.

blocks.name: Attach effect to object
blocks.doc: Adds a continuous emitter that follows the object.

blocks.name: Trigger burst
blocks.doc: Emits particles from the emitter object (or its attached effect).

blocks.name: Start emission
blocks.doc: Starts or restarts an emitter.

blocks.name: Stop emission
blocks.doc: Stops emitting (existing particles finish their life).

blocks.name: Set particle property
blocks.doc: Changes emission rate, lifetime, speed, gravity, size...

blocks.name: Set particle color
blocks.doc: Changes color over lifetime.

blocks.name: Shake camera
blocks.doc: Shakes the active camera.

blocks.name: Set active camera
blocks.doc: Switches rendering to this camera.

blocks.name: Set focal length
blocks.doc: Blender-style lens zoom.

blocks.name: Set camera clipping
blocks.doc: Blender "Clip Start / End".

blocks.name: Set 2D zoom
blocks.doc: Zooms 2D / orthographic views (1 = 100%).

blocks.name: Apply post-processing preset
blocks.doc: Replaces the active camera effect stack with a preset.

blocks.name: Enable or disable effect
blocks.doc: Turns one effect on the active camera on or off (adds it if missing).

blocks.name: Set effect parameter
blocks.doc: Changes any parameter: bloom strength, vignette amount, pixel size, saturation, focus distance...

blocks.name: Set bloom intensity
blocks.doc: Enables bloom with the given strength.

blocks.name: Enable pixelation
blocks.doc: Pixelates the image (0 disables).

blocks.name: Enable PS1-style effects
blocks.doc: Low resolution, vertex snapping, affine textures, dithering and color banding.

blocks.name: Set vignette
blocks.doc: Darkens the edges.

blocks.name: Change depth of field
blocks.text: Set depth of field focus {focus} f/{fstop}
blocks.doc: Blender-style depth of field on the active camera.

blocks.name: Change color grading
blocks.doc: Adjusts saturation, contrast and warmth.

blocks.name: Show message
blocks.doc: Shows a banner in the middle of the screen.

blocks.name: Update text
blocks.doc: Changes a text object.

blocks.name: Update health bar
blocks.doc: Turns a text object into a progress/health bar.

blocks.name: Show menu
blocks.doc: Shows every object tagged with the menu tag.

blocks.name: Hide menu
blocks.doc: Hides every object tagged with the menu tag.

blocks.name: Pause game
blocks.doc: Sets time scale to 0. Events still run so you can resume with a key.

blocks.name: Resume game
blocks.doc: Sets time scale back to 1.

blocks.name: Set time scale
blocks.doc: Slow motion (<1) or fast forward (>1).

blocks.name: Restart scene
blocks.doc: Resets the scene to its starting state.

blocks.name: Load scene
blocks.doc: Changes level.

blocks.name: Set checkpoint
blocks.doc: Remembers the position of the picked object (use with Respawn at checkpoint).

blocks.name: Respawn at checkpoint
blocks.doc: Moves the object to the last checkpoint (or its start).

blocks.name: Display victory screen
blocks.doc: Shows the victory screen with Restart, and stops gameplay.

blocks.name: Display defeat screen
blocks.doc: Shows the defeat screen with Restart, and stops gameplay.

blocks.name: Play animation
blocks.doc: Plays a keyframe clip from the Animation editor, an imported (glTF/FBX) clip, or a sprite animation.

blocks.name: Stop animation
blocks.doc: Stops the current animation.

blocks.name: Tween property
blocks.doc: Smoothly animates a property.
